run_when: Code found no Product Hunt link or engineering blog, but a blog exists.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company shows an early-adopter posture: Product Hunt launches, an engineering blog, or public writing about the tools they build with.
yes_when: Posts about their tech or tool stack
no_when: Not applicable; use unknown when nothing is found
watch_out_for: A marketing blog alone is not enough

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Engineering blog: How we migrated our queue to Postgres

output.evidence_quote: How we migrated our queue to Postgres
output.reason: The company writes publicly about its own engineering.
